messages.speaker: Marcus Lee
messages.content: When a hot product key expires, hundreds of requests hit PostgreSQL at once. We saw a latency spike at the top of the hour.

messages.speaker: Priya Raman
messages.content: Add jitter to TTLs so keys do not expire together, and a short per-key lock so only one request refills the cache.

messages.speaker: Marcus Lee
messages.content: Agreed. I'll write it up in TKT-112 and add a step to the Redis runbook.
